free_tier.stated: Get USD 1,000 in cloud credits to build AI with on-demand GPU instances on Lambda Cloud. Covers on-demand NVIDIA B200, H100 and A100 GPUs plus GH200 Grace Hopper Superchips, with no ingress or egress fees, and covers persistent storage at USD 0.20/GB/month. One grant per company. Credits valid 12 months.

interface_detail: inferred from the tooling the provider documents; not probed
chaining: USD 1,000 on Lambda buys several hundred hours of a single H100 at published hourly rates, enough to fine-tune a small model and not enough to pretrain. It composes with Inception membership only, and membership is the failing link.

limits.value: Inception membership fails first on incorporation, and a card is mandatory anyway; the USD 1,000 is a trial-size amount rather than a workload.

identity_cost.detail: Requires current NVIDIA Inception membership, which requires official incorporation, plus a credit card issued in one of the listed countries. The eligible list includes the EU except Lithuania, the UK, the US, Japan, South Korea, Singapore, Taiwan, Turkey and others.

evidence.proved: 'Get USD 1,000 in cloud credits', covering B200, H100, A100 and GH200 on-demand, one grant per company, valid 12 months, quoted
'A valid credit card is required to prevent fraud and calculate tax' and the country list for eligibility, quoted

notes: Third-party listings disagree on the amount, ranging from USD 1,000 to USD 7,500. The vendor page says USD 1,000, so USD 1,000 is recorded. This is not a standalone Lambda startup program.
